The '''P-2B Assault Droid''' was a model of three-legged [[Tank Buster droid]], available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The P-2B was designed solely to dominate the battlefield, and could be upgraded to use plasma cell ammo. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] arms dealer [[Olok]] the Shadow sold P-2B Assault Droids in his auction on [[Darvannis]].

==Behind the scenes==
P-2B Assault Droids appear as one of the four types of droid enemies in the Olok the Shadow boss encounter in the Operation "Scum and Villainy," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']].<ref name="TOR" />
